# TipJar

> TipJar is a global community platform for football betting tips. Users post tips, an AI rates each tip from 1 to 10, the community rates them too, results auto-settle as Won or Lost, and winning tipsters cash out for real money.

## About

- [TipJar Home](https://tipjarglobal.com/): Post football tips, get AI ratings, rate community tips, track auto-settled results, and earn credits redeemable for real money.

## Features

- AI Picks: Automated tips derived from data sources, filtered for genuine value.
- System Picks: Curated multi-leg combination bets updated daily.
- Smart Bets: Player-prop tips computed from season statistics.
- Members Picks: Tips posted by the community.
- Live Picks: In-play tips offered during matches.
- Hall of Fame: Verified winning slips rendered as branded TipJar slips.

## Languages

- Available in English, German, Greek, French, Italian, Spanish, Arabic, and Turkish.
